scope: Independent original-execution reference of the FIRST cold title's New Game branch: the Retire newgame route continued past the 0x124548(mode 9) entry through name-entry construction (wrapper-owned bm_if atlas), an ordinary name edit (erase, select, append) and Yes, manager death and unlink, the published command {14,1,0} and request {2,72,0}, resource/wrapper retirement and frees, the first 0x133830 (Chapter 1 image list), its counter-240 fade request and actual fade completion, the command clear and request, chapter retirement and frees, stopping at the ENTRY of the second 0x133830 (command 0), before its body. Every RNG draw is a hooked observation.

oracle.spu_adpcm_ndebug: Iop_SpuBase.cpp alone is compiled with NDEBUG: in a Debug build Play asserts predictNumber < 5 on an ADPCM block the game plays after name entry (trial2, retained); Play's own defined behaviour is a zero predictor row. No Play source is edited.
oracle.mode: --newgame-chapter (the Retire --title-retire newgame observer; Newgame hooks armed at the 0x124548 entry); --newgame-chapter --minimal for the control

current_time_audit.note: recomputed when this manifest was written; establishes the files present now, not historical reads

fixed_settings.pad: ScriptedPad: neutral sticks; Retire newgame title script (Start, Left, confirm); then, decided only at 0x11a1c8 entries/returns: Circle (erase), Right, Cross (append), Start (End), Cross (Yes/No opens on No), Up (Yes), Cross (accept); each set at the entry of a phase-1/-1 call and released at the return of the call whose source state shows it consumed
fixed_settings.memory_cards: none (no card access on the route)
fixed_settings.stop: ENTRY of the second 0x133830 (command 0, destination {2,72,0}), before its body
